archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Retro-Futurism / Technical

headings.styling: tracking-tight, high contrast white, never centered unless in an empty state.

mono.styling: Used exclusively for code input, line numbers, and data metrics (like the audit score).

rules: H1 up to text-5xl tracking-tighter, never larger.
Overlines MUST be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].
Line numbers in editor MUST be muted text-zinc-600.
Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure grey. Always slightly tinted with zinc/slate from Tailwind.
Gradients only on specific hover states or glowing borders. The tool should feel structural and precise.
High contrast for all text (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
Action buttons (like 'Run Audit') should use primary accent (White bg, Black text) for high visibility.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeleton, border-collapse styles. Panels and cards use flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-zinc-800), no shadows.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle noise/grain texture overlaid on the main background (`mix-blend-overlay`, opacity 0.03) to break the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating sticky header: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/60` with 1px `border-white/10` bottom border. Never fully transparent.

components.Header: Sticky, glassmorphism, brand logo on left, 'Run Audit' primary CTA on right.
components.Editor_Panel: Left panel on desktop. Dark background (#18181B). Features a monospace textarea or code editor wrapper. Provide a clear 'Paste your code here...' placeholder.
components.Audit_Results_Panel: Right panel. Empty state shows an icon and 'Awaiting code input...'. Active state shows Overall Score (large JetBrains Mono text) and a list of categorized findings.
components.Findings_Card: Sharp edges (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). Left border colored by severity (Red for Critical, Yellow for Warning). Contains line number reference, category, and explanation.
components.CTA_Buttons: Sharp rectangular (`rounded-md`) with 1px border. Hover state triggers a subtle internal glow or background color shift. Primary CTA is High Contrast.

grids_layouts.page_structure: Full-height app layout (`h-screen`). Avoid scrolling the entire page; instead, independently scroll the Editor Panel and the Results Panel using `overflow-y-auto`.
grids_layouts.desktop: Grid layout: `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-px bg-zinc-800` (creates a 1px border between the two panels). Left: Editor, Right: Results.
grids_layouts.mobile: Grid layout: `grid grid-cols-1`. Stacked layout. Results appear below the editor.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous padding inside panels (`p-6` to `p-12`). Utilize the Bento grid protocol for any summary widgets in the Results Panel.

rules: Micro-animations on all interactive elements (hover states, focus rings).
Staggered entrance animations for the audit findings list (e.g., using Framer Motion or clean CSS transitions).
Use specific transitions like `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.
Add `data-testid` on all buttons, inputs, tabs, and results cards for testing.
Focus states MUST be high contrast ring (e.g., `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white focus:outline-none`).
Color-blind friendly severity indicators: Always combine color with explicit text labels (e.g., 'CRITICAL') and icons.

hero_background.description: Abstract geometric texture to be used with mix-blend-overlay and very low opacity (e.g., 5%) on the main app wrapper to kill digital flatness.

media.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Provide sharp, technical icons (e.g., Terminal, Shield, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 2-panel split layout using Tailwind CSS. Left side for Code Input, Right side for Audit Results.
Ensure layout takes up `h-screen` and prevents body scrolling. Both panels should scroll independently.

Implement the offline audit logic completely in the frontend. Create a simple JavaScript/TypeScript regex-based function to simulate detecting vulnerabilities (e.g., detecting 'eval', 'console.log', 'var', 'localStorage').
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' if it forces heavy shadows; override default classes to be flat, 1px bordered with technical aesthetic.
Ensure the right panel has an 'Overall Score' widget (large typography) and a findings list. Group findings by Severity (Critical, Warning, Info).
Add 'Copy Results' and 'Clear' buttons in the Results panel or header.
Left-align text in the editor and results. Never center-align dense data.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Apply the defined typography strictly (Cabinet Grotesk for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body, JetBrains Mono for code).
Create depth through 1px borders and selective background lightenings, not heavy drop shadows (since this is dark mode).
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific CSS transitions.
Never use placeholder text or placeholder image URLs.
All interactions need micro-animations (hover, active, focus states).
Use generous spacing (`p-6` to `p-12`) inside panels.
Do NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`. Disrupts reading flow.
